# Data and Information

**Data** is raw, uninterpreted signal: measurements, logs, tokens. On its own
it carries no meaning.

**Information** is data placed in context — structured, filtered, and related so
it answers "what / who / when / where". Turning data into information is the
first act of interpretation.

This page anchors the lower two layers of the [[DIKW Overview]]. The next step
up — turning information into reusable, connected understanding — is covered in
[[Knowledge and Wisdom]].
